<style>

  * { box-sizing: border-box; margin: 0; padding: 0; }
  body { font-family: "Open Sans", Roboto, Arial, sans-serif; color: var(--texto); background: #fff; line-height: 1.6; }
  a { color: var(--royal); text-decoration: none; }
  .wrap { max-width: 1120px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 0 20px; }
  h1, h2, h3 { color: var(--marino); line-height: 1.2; font-weight: 800; }
  h2 { font-size: 2rem; margin-bottom: 10px; }
  h3 { font-size: 1.1rem; margin-bottom: 6px; }
  section { padding: 72px 0; }
  .alt { background: var(--suave); }
  .lead { color: #4a5266; font-size: 1.05rem; max-width: 720px; }
  .eyebrow { display: inline-block; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: 2px; font-size: .78rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); margin-bottom: 10px; }
  .btn { display: inline-block; padding: 14px 26px; border-radius: 6px; font-weight: 700; font-size: .95rem; margin: 6px 8px 6px 0; }
  .btn-primary { background: var(--royal); color: #fff; }
  .btn-primary:hover { background: var(--celeste); }

  /* Icono WhatsApp */
  .wa { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 56px; height: 56px; border-radius: 50%; background: var(--verde); box-shadow: 0 4px 14px rgba(31,170,89,.35); transition: transform .15s ease; margin: 6px 8px 6px 0; vertical-align: middle; }
  .wa:hover { transform: scale(1.06); }
  .wa svg { width: 28px; height: 28px; fill: #fff; }
  .wa.sm { width: 42px; height: 42px; margin: 0; box-shadow: none; }
  .wa.sm svg { width: 22px; height: 22px; }
  .wa.light { background: #fff; }
  .wa.light svg { fill: var(--verde); }

  /* Encabezado */
  header { position: sticky; top: 0; background: #fff; border-bottom: 1px solid #e6e9f0; z-index: 10; }
  .nav { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; height: 72px; flex-wrap: wrap; }
  .logo { height: 58px; width: auto; display: block; }
  .menu { display: flex; align-items: center; }
  .menu a.link { color: var(--texto); margin-left: 24px; font-size: .95rem; font-weight: 600; }
  .menu a.link:hover { color: var(--royal); }
  .menu .wa { margin-left: 24px; }

  /* Inicio */
  .hero {
    min-height: 620px; display: flex; align-items: center; color: #fff;
    background: linear-gradient(115deg, rgba(11,31,92,.95) 0%, rgba(11,31,92,.78) 55%, rgba(30,99,224,.5) 100%),
                url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center/cover no-repeat, var(--marino);
  }
  .hero h1 { color: #fff; font-size: 3.6rem; max-width: 760px; }
  .hero p.sub { font-size: 1.2rem; color: #dbe6ff; max-width: 640px; margin: 22px 0 32px; }
  .hero .eyebrow { color: var(--celeste); }

  /* Catálogo */
  .grupo-titulo { font-size: 1.25rem; margin: 40px 0 16px; color: var(--marino); }
  .modelos { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fill, minmax(210px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; }
  .modelo { background: #fff; border-radius: 12px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 12px rgba(11,31,92,.08); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .modelo img { width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 3 / 4; object-fit: cover; display: block; }
  .modelo .info { padding: 16px 16px 18px; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 10px; }
  .modelo h3 { font-size: 1rem; margin: 0 0 2px; }
  .modelo p { font-size: .88rem; color: #4a5266; }

  /* Servicios */
  .servicios { display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(230px, 1fr)); gap: 20px; margin-top: 30px; }
  .servicio { background: #fff; border-radius: 10px; overflow: hidden; box-shadow: 0 2px 10px rgba(11,31,92,.07); display: flex; flex-direction: column; }
  .fotos { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
  .fotos.dos { grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; }
  .fotos img { width: 100%; height: auto; display: block; margin: 0 auto; }
  .servicio .texto { padding: 22px; border-top: 4px solid var(--celeste); }
  .servicio p { color: #4a5266; font-size: .95rem; }

  /* Nosotros */
  .nosotros { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 50px; align-items: center; }
  .destacado { font-size: 1.35rem; font-weight: 700; color: var(--royal); margin: 6px 0 14px; }
  .foto-local { width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 12px; box-shadow: 0 6px 24px rgba(11,31,92,.15); display: block; }

  /* Franja de cierre */
  .franja-cta { background: var(--royal); color: #fff; padding: 56px 0; text-align: center; }
  .franja-cta h2 { color: #fff; }
  .franja-cta p { margin: 12px 0 26px; font-size: 1.1rem; }

  /* Contacto */
  .contacto { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1fr; gap: 50px; }
  .dato { margin-bottom: 20px; }
  .dato b { display: block; color: var(--marino); font-size: .85rem; text-transform: uppercase; letter-spacing: .5px; }
  .cta-centro { text-align: center; margin-top: 34px; }
  .franja-foto { background: linear-gradient(rgba(11,31,92,.80), rgba(11,31,92,.80)), url("data:image/jpeg;base64,") center/cover no-repeat; padding: 96px 0; }
  .franja-foto h2 { font-size: 2.8rem; }
  .foto-contacto { width: 100%; height: auto; border-radius: 12px; margin: 0 0 26px; display: block; box-shadow: 0 6px 20px rgba(11,31,92,.15); }
  footer { background: var(--marino); color: #d7def0; padding: 28px 0; font-size: .88rem; }
  footer a { color: #fff; }

  @media (max-width: 860px) {
    .hero h1 { font-size: 2.4rem; }
    .menu a.link { display: none; }
    .menu .wa { margin-left: 0; }
    .nosotros, .contacto { grid-template-columns: 1fr; }
    section { padding: 52px 0; }
  }
</style>
